column4: Thanks for joining, David. Before we talk numbers, how has the quarter gone for your team?
Busy, honestly. Volume is up twenty percent, and the reporting dashboard has been really useful.
That's great to hear. You mentioned last time that onboarding new staff was slow.
Yes. We would like two more training sessions in January, ideally remote.
We can include those in the renewal at no extra cost. I will confirm dates with our training team.
Perfect. The other question is data retention. Legal wants us to keep records for seven years.
Our standard plan keeps five years. Seven years is an add on, and I will send you the pricing.
Please do. If the numbers work, we can sign before the end of the month.
Great. So my actions are the training dates and the retention pricing, both by Friday.
Before you go, should we invite your operations lead to the training sessions as well?
Yes, please add her. She will want to see the new reporting features.
And I will get sign off from our legal team. Talk soon.
